panels.heading: Update the plan

notes: Also: share the 3 key messages with your team the day after. Review the KFFM in every weekly leadership meeting. Keep running all company meetings through Metronome. Add the widget-based company metric, if defined.
The two surveys are the Metronomics Checklist Survey and the Kick-Off and Annual prep survey.
The CEO starts the weekly email this week.
Give every item an owner and a date (What, Owner, By When), as on the board’s Homework area.
